description: Role vectors: role separation at creation and on every change, set bounds, which role may call each function, caller authorization, the attester key overlap, removed and re-added agents, and the principal transfer.

vectors.description: Every call the principal may not make is refused with UNAUTHORIZED, as a host authorization failure on Stellar for principal-only calls, and nothing changes.
Every call an agent may not make is refused with UNAUTHORIZED, as a host authorization failure on Stellar for principal-only calls, and nothing changes.
Every call an approver may not make is refused with UNAUTHORIZED, as a host authorization failure on Stellar for principal-only calls, and nothing changes.
Every call a guardian may not make is refused with UNAUTHORIZED, as a host authorization failure on Stellar for principal-only calls, and nothing changes.
Every call an executor may not make is refused with UNAUTHORIZED, as a host authorization failure on Stellar for principal-only calls, and nothing changes.
Every call a recovery approver may not make is refused with UNAUTHORIZED, as a host authorization failure on Stellar for principal-only calls, and nothing changes.
Every call an address with no role may not make is refused with UNAUTHORIZED, as a host authorization failure on Stellar for principal-only calls, and nothing changes.
Every call the fee address may not make is refused with UNAUTHORIZED, as a host authorization failure on Stellar for principal-only calls, and nothing changes.
Each role makes exactly the calls it may: agents request and cancel their own, approvers approve and reject, executors execute, and pausers pause.
The fee address holds no role, yet like anyone it may cancel a payout once it lapses.
A guardian can pause, but its resume and withdraw fail authorization and its approve and execute are UNAUTHORIZED.
An executor's execute of a PENDING payout is PAYOUT_WRONG_STATUS; once an approver approves it, the executor executes it.
create refuses with ROLE_CONFLICT every forbidden overlap: the principal as agent, executor or recovery approver, shared seats, and the fee address anywhere.
Every allowed overlap is accepted at creation, and each seat keeps its powers: the principal approves, guardians that hold other roles use both.
add_role refuses with ROLE_CONFLICT every forbidden overlap, including an agent as approver or executor and the fee address in any set.
add_role and remove_role succeed for every role code with role_added and role_removed, and an added agent takes the next agent_epoch.
add_role and remove_role refuse an unknown role code, adding an address already in the set and removing one not in it, with CONFIG_INVALID.
With every role set at its bound, adding one more member is ROLE_SET_FULL, while a conflicting add is still ROLE_CONFLICT first.
Each role set can be filled to exactly its bound, and a freed seat can be taken again.
create refuses 9 agents, 11 approvers, 5 guardians, 5 executors or 11 recovery approvers with ROLE_SET_FULL.
A call naming another address as caller without its signature fails host authorization on Stellar; on Celo the signer is the caller and is refused.
After expiry a sweep naming the principal as caller but signed by another address fails authorization on Stellar and the grace guard on Celo.
On Celo, create with the zero address in any role set is CONFIG_INVALID.
On Celo a configuration naming the zero address as principal is refused at the caller check, since the zero address can never send create.
On Celo, add_role of the zero address for every role and propose_principal of it are CONFIG_INVALID.
A recovery rotation with no new agent, which Celo encodes as the zero address, removes the old agent without reaching the zero address check.
After remove_role of an agent, approve and execute of its payouts are AGENT_REMOVED, it cannot cancel them, the principal can, and anyone once lapsed.
After a recovery rotation replaces an agent, approve and execute of its payouts are AGENT_REMOVED and the principal can still cancel them.
An agent removed and added again takes agent_epoch 1, so its epoch 0 payouts stay AGENT_REMOVED and its own cancel is refused, while a new payout runs.
An agent rotated out by recovery and added back by the principal takes a new agent_epoch, so its old payouts stay AGENT_REMOVED.
An agent cancels its own payout with reason 2, but another agent's live payout is UNAUTHORIZED for it.
A recovery rotation refuses a new agent that is an executor, approver, recovery approver, the principal or the fee address, with ROLE_CONFLICT.
On Stellar create refuses an attester key equal to the key of the principal, the fee address or any role account, with ROLE_CONFLICT.
On Stellar add_role of the account whose key is the attester key is ROLE_CONFLICT for every role.
On Stellar set_attestation_policy refuses the key of the principal, the fee address or any role account with ROLE_CONFLICT.
On Stellar proposing as principal the account whose key is the attester key is ROLE_CONFLICT.
On Stellar a proposed principal whose key became the attester key after the proposal cannot accept (ROLE_CONFLICT) until the policy changes.
On Stellar the key of an account that holds no role may be the attester, and every role path stays open for other accounts.
On Stellar a recovery rotation to the account whose key is the attester key is ROLE_CONFLICT.
A proposed approver accepts, since principal and approver may overlap, and then approves a payout as the new principal.
A proposed address that a recovery rotation made an agent cannot accept, with ROLE_CONFLICT.
The principal cannot sit in the recovery set: at create, through add_role, as a proposed recovery approver, or at acceptance after joining it.
The principal may also be a guardian and an approver: it pauses as guardian and approves as approver.
